propositions: Environment-read helper functions not registered in KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table are silently skipped by the scanner, causing their env vars to be missing from docs/env-vars.md
Two real operator-settable variables (REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE) are currently undocumented because _gate_str_pref helper lacks a registry row despite being advertised in CLI help
The registry generator fails closed for unrecognized os.environ accessors but fails open for unregistered helpers, creating asymmetric failure modes for the same hazard class

Parameterized-shim detection (functions whose env-var key expression references their own parameters) provides a closed, enumerable trigger for identifying missing helper registrations across 557 source files with 1.6% hit rate

Adding a missing KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS row for _gate_str_pref reveals exactly two undocumented keys (REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE), confirming the mechanism and measuring the defect as live rather than latent
